text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Y'know, I don't think I've changed<n>all that much.
I've always run for me,<n>just because I like doing it.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
But I had you and everyone else who<n>saw your
dreams in me, and called<n>out to me, and supported
me.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: And that's why I'm here now.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Thanks! And I'll keep running a<n>whole lot, just
because I want to.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: So keep watching. And we can dream<n>on together.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Haven't seen you since last year's<n>Arima, Ines.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
My heart's burning. It's on fire. It<n>has been since
the day we raced.<n>And—

text_block_list.name: Oguri Fan
text_block_list.text: Oguriiiiin! You can win this! Keep on<n>running!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: I'm Oguri Cap. So I've got nothing to<n>worry about.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
I'm not worried either! I promise I'm<n>gonna live up
to the expectations of<n>everyone cheering me on!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Ryan! Ahaha, you're as tough as<n>ever.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Hey! I could say the same about you,<n>Ines.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: But I'm not planning on losing today. Iam Mejiro Ryan, after all.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Guess it's time for me to make adeclaration too! In today's race, I'mgonna have more fun than anyone!
